linkedin_text:
Not every lead deserves your time.

When you're running a lean team or a startup, it's tempting to chase down every single person who fills out a form. But spending hours trying to revive a lukewarm lead is the fastest way to burn out.

A lead worth chasing usually shows three clear signals: they have an urgent problem they want fixed now, they actually respond to your questions, and they recognize that real solutions require real investment.

If you have to follow up four times just to get a "maybe," let them go. The best prospects lean in—they don't make you play hide-and-seek.

How do you usually spot a tire-kicker before you hop on a call?

instagram_text:
Stop chasing every single lead.

Your time is your most valuable asset—don't burn it on people who aren't ready to buy.

Here’s a quick gut-check for your next inquiry:
✨ They have an urgent problem to solve
✨ They engage and reply promptly
✨ They respect your value and pricing

If they ghost you early on, let them go. Focus on the ones who are ready to grow with you.
